edits.old: Screen-level behaviour remains with the owning APP stories.
edits.new: Screen-level behaviour remains with the owning APP stories. The transfer reason codes in LOV-TRANSFER-REASON are reference data read at run time and loaded through the reference-load surface of rwb-case; the Centre of excellence and the data steward own the list, and each addition, change or retirement of a code is a dated reference load approved by a second person, as for the permission matrix. The operations of the consumed contracts are taken from the CON story of each owner as published (case transfer, case read, LOV-TRANSFER-REASON reference read, rwb-decision package read, rwb-access authorise call, rwb-source-data case-facts read) and called through the generated client within the 2 s budget and the breaker of DP-11. The case status and legal-hold events are consumed under the consumer group placeholder, faked by the platform inbox stub, and bound when the rwb-case event catalogue fixes their names. The activity timeouts of EvaluateRules and RecordAndApply and the alert thresholds for move rate, refusal rate by code, at-cap hits, budget breaches and dead-letter depth are confirmed with the service owner of rwb-case before the capability is switched on in UAT and recorded in the values files as confirmed values: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0713).

| Contract dependencies | RWB-P3-E1043-CON, RWB-P7-E1073-CON; platform contracts tracked and gating the build at pickup: RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-E1072-CON, RWB-PLT-E1043-CON, RWB-PLT-TE006-CON, RWB-PLT-E1071-CON, RWB-PLT-E1047-CON, RWB-PLT-E1044-CON, RWB-PLT-N001-CON |
